speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I need the performance monitoring to be fully governed, not just partially automated. The current proposal leaves too much room for silent failures that will hurt our users.
output.correction: You misread my request as a simple automation task. I am specifically asking for governance controls that enforce reliability standards, not just scripts that run on a schedule.
